programme.desc: Ellie's ex, Greg, is best man at her sister's wedding at a beach resort in Acapulco. When the bride and groom miss their airplanes, it's up to Ellie and Greg to make decisions concerning the wedding etc. so they're forced together a lot.

programme.title: Marilyn Monroe: Fascination
programme.desc: Marilyn Monroe endured criticism, insecurity, drug dependence, miscarriages and broken marriages, yet she managed to parlay her beauty, talent and quick wit into a career.

programme.title: A Day at the Beach
programme.desc: Directed in conjunction with Roman Polanski, this drama paints a cruel portrait of life in a dilapidated British seaside town, when an alcoholic disintegrates in the company of his young daughter. Peter Sellers steals scenes in a cameo performance.

programme.title: Once Bitten
programme.desc: A centuries-old vampiress comes to Los Angeles and stalks male virgins, she needs their blood to retain her youth and beauty. Her targets are left with an appetite for raw hamburgers and a tendency to sleep during the day so as to avoid sunlight.

programme.title: Come Play with Me
programme.desc: A health-resort where both the clients and the employees easily take their clothes off and have a little fun is the setting of this sex-comedy. Starring: Irene Handl, Alfie Bass. Guinness Book Of World Records lists it's 210 week cinematic run

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: A godless Comanchero, left to die on a torture rack by members of his own band, is rescued by a pair of nuns.

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: Gil Favor and Rowdy Yates are captured by the people of a Mexican settlement in Texas and falsely accused of trespassing and murder.

programme.title: Rawhide
programme.desc: A frontier wedding becomes a struggle of wills when an angry father comes to take his daughter away from her bridegroom.

programme.title: Garringo
programme.desc: Johnny witnesses the murder of his father, an officer accused of treason. Adopted by a sheriff, Johnny grows up with the trauma of this crime and leads a double life. The friendly and loving young man is in reality a wild outlaw.

programme.title: Halleluja for Django
programme.desc: A gang sets up a Middletown bank robbery, a perfect heist that yields a haul of half a million dollars in gold coins. The robbers go their separate ways, only to meet up a short time later in a town near the Mexican border to split the money, as arranged.

programme.title: Resistance
programme.desc: Based on the acclaimed novel. 1944: The D-Day landings have failed, and the German Wehrmacht has invaded Britain. The country is now under enemy occupation. In a remote valley in the Black Mountains of Wales, the women awake to discover the men are gone.

programme.title: Bending The Rules
programme.desc: Theo Gold, the New Orleans Assistant District Attorney, is about to have the worst day of his life. Not only does his wife decide to leave him on the eve of his birthday, but he manages to lose a high-profile case.

programme.title: The Negotiator

programme.title: Web of Lies

programme.title: Blown Away

programme.title: SpaceWalker

A family man struggling to hold it all together discovers a hidden parlor that offers a solution...sexbots.
